description: This file is a PHP script that generates a troubleshooting diagnostics page for MoCA (Multimedia over Coax Alliance) devices. It includes server-side PHP code to retrieve network information and outputs an HTML page with embedded JavaScript for visualizing the MoCA network diagram and device details.

methods.name: div_mod
methods.description: Performs integer division and modulus operation, returning quotient and remainder as an array.

methods.name: init_psmMode
methods.description: Initializes the page mode or navigation state for troubleshooting sections.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Fetches a set of parameters based on a given key prefix and array of parameter names.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves multiple parameter values for a specific object path.
